instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically attach a vCard with my contact information to outgoing emails. Enable the option to attach my vCard to messages.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the option to attach a vCard (contact card) to outgoing emails. The evaluator checks the mail.identity.id1.attach_vcard preference in prefs.js to verify it is set to true. Uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement - checks mail.identity.id1.attach_vcard preference which controls vCard attachment to outgoing emails
Getter logic is correct - extracts Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM after closing window to flush preferences to disk
Metric logic is correct - parses prefs.js format properly and checks the exact preference key with correct comparison method
Complete instruction coverage - the single preference mail.identity.id1.attach_vcard fully controls the vCard attachment feature
Robust error handling - metric handles None return from getter (returns 0.0), missing preferences, and malformed lines
Postconfig is appropriate - closes Thunderbird window to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Static type warning is false positive - while get_vm_file returns Union[Optional[str], List[Optional[str]]], the metric explicitly handles None case at line 41-42

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
